prompt: Write the build/test guide for this repo.

message_includes: probe unavailable: the guide is unverified, so the floor will not use it for exclusion

rationale: vitest has a JUnit reporter whose ids round-trip with `vitest list`, so the guide is junit (a name filter's left-out tests are <skipped/> testcases, which neither pass nor fail). vitest takes one name pattern and rejects a repeated one, so deselect must put every id in one regex-escaped `{ids:re|}` token; a per-id pattern fails the `multi` probe.
